about.title: About Me
about.description: My name is Egor Zheludkov. I am a mobile and desktop developer. I started working in the IT industry in 2018 as a WPF developer. In early 2022, I transitioned to mobile development using Xamarin Native. Since the beginning of 2024, I've been working with Flutter. I am also the founder of a startup – Ovdix.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Experienced Flutter engineer who quickly adapts to any codebase and focuses on business results. I build productive relationships with designers, analysts, and managers, helping to focus on tasks that bring the most value. I practice 'small iterations': breaking features into tasks that can be completed in a day and immediately integrated into the build. I conduct thorough code reviews and provide detailed recommendations that improve code quality and team processes. My approach accelerates releases and reduces risks, allowing products to grow quickly and deliver value to the business.
